name: Ji Ming
source:
He recently broke up with his girlfriend and lost his purpose in life. Therefore, one day he enters a deep forest where he finds a strange cave. On the other side of the cave there is a beautiful village called Taohuayuan (Peach Blossom Spring).
[spoiler]In reality, he is a private detective entrusted to find the lost daughter of a businessman. The girl apparently disappeared in a place associated with the legend of Peach Blossom Spring. After a fruitless search, the protagonist decides to resort to unusual means - he asks his friend who specializes in hypnosis to temporarily alter his personality so that Peach Blossom Spring would "accept" him.[/spoiler]
